entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana, agent ID 401. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, I... I think I need to make a return? I have this helmet and I'm just not sure about it. It's all very confusing.
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, could I have your name and order number, please?
My name is Sam Jones, and the order number is... uh... VF88602. I think.
Thank you, Sam. I see the order for the AeroSafe Helmet here. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault with the helmet or more of a preference?

Oh, no, it's not broken or anything. The color just isn't what I thought it would be from the website. It's... too bright. The box is still unopened, I haven't even touched it. I just don't know what to do.
I understand. It can be difficult to get a true sense of color online sometimes. Let me just pull up your delivery date... It looks like it was delivered 25 days ago. Let me check our policy for you.
25 days? Is that bad? Oh dear, the website was so complicated. Can't you just help me? I just want to send it back.

Of course, Sam. It's no problem at all. According to our policy, you have 90 days from the date of delivery to return an item. Since you're at 25 days, you are well within the window for a full refund.
Oh! Really? That's... that's such a relief. Thank you!

You're very welcome. We do require that the item is in its original condition, but since you mentioned the box is unopened, that's perfect. For an item like a helmet, we have to be very careful about safety standards, so an unused item is easy to process. I've just sent a pre-paid return label to the email on your account. Just print it out, attach it to the package, and drop it off at any post office.
Wow, that's it? Thank you so much, Diana. You've been a great help.
Happy to assist, Sam. Once we receive the helmet, your refund will be processed within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
You're welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
